requiredFindings.title: Fund the selected merge sort’s scratch index as well as its output index
requiredFindings.detail: LC-2 (line 7) and LD-CIP-4 select C2a r4 R3-RF-2’s deterministic bottom-up merge sort but price only one owned index: one object and 4*n bytes. The cited C2a recipe explicitly prices two u32 index buffers at objects 2 and 2*n*size_of::<u32>() bytes (c2a/PLAN-r4.md:172-175). Its merge passes use a destination/scratch buffer in addition to the source index. No alternate one-buffer merge mechanism with the stated comparison bound is specified here. Consequently the proposed B_install correction omits one owned object and 4*n bytes of selected algorithm storage: 400,000 bytes at 100,000 entries. This affects the pre-acquisition admission bound and actual charge-before-allocation, not merely an implementation optimization.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Make LC-2 and LD-CIP-4 name and price both u32 index buffers (objects 2, bytes 2*n*size_of::<u32>(), with checked arithmetic), include the complete ordering bound in B_install before acquisition, and charge each allocation before it occurs. Alternatively specify a concrete one-buffer algorithm and justify its actual storage and worst-case comparison bound rather than borrowing the two-buffer recipe’s bound. Extend CI-T22/focused controls to independently account for every ordering allocation and comparison, including refusal before an unfunded scratch allocation/comparison; a missing scratch charge must be caught. Carry the corrected complete price into the lead’s LC-2 law disposition.
